# TRAVNY

> Canonical map of the public TRAVNY hub, services, machine-readable guides and small technical publications.

Canonical hub: https://trfny.com/

## Main routes

- [Hub](https://trfny.com/) · [Markdown](https://trfny.com/index.md)
- [TVPI](https://trfny.com/tv/) · [Markdown](https://trfny.com/tv/index.md)
- [Teksty](https://trfny.com/teksty/) · [Markdown](https://trfny.com/teksty/index.md)
- [Tokenowy Mundial AI](https://trfny.com/teksty/token-worldcup/): token-count comparison for equivalent text in 27 languages using `o200k_base`

## Services

- [TVPI streaming Worker](https://tvpi.trfny.com/) · [LLM guide](https://tvpi.trfny.com/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://tvpi.trfny.com/llms-full.txt) · [playlist](https://tvpi.trfny.com/playlist.m3u)
- [Weather](https://weather.trfny.com/) · [LLM guide](https://weather.trfny.com/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://weather.trfny.com/llms-full.txt) · [state JSON](https://weather.trfny.com/state.json)
- [Feedseek](https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/) · [LLM guide](https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/llms-full.txt) · [OPML](https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/subscriptions.opml)
- [Streambench](https://streambench.trfny.com/) · [LLM guide](https://streambench.trfny.com/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://streambench.trfny.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Code Bench](https://codebench.trfny.com/) · [LLM guide](https://codebench.trfny.com/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://codebench.trfny.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Doc Bench](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/) · [LLM guide](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Usage notes

- TVPI upstream HLS signatures are short-lived. Persist the stable `tvpi.trfny.com` endpoints, not resolved tokenized upstream URLs.
- Weather is a multi-source local ensemble for Kościelec in Chrzanów with air quality, pollen and IMGW warnings.
- Streambench, Code Bench and Doc Bench are local-first browser tools; their own LLM guides document privacy and agent-access boundaries.
- Tokenowy Mundial AI is maintained as Quarto source in `trvny/trvny` and proxied by TRAVNY from its verified generated HTML.
